skills.name: Earthen Grip
skills.description:
Calls forth a hand from the ground to hold an enemy, inflicting Snare for 17s.
Deals 897 (806 + 220% Magic Attack) Magic Damage on expiration.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.

skills.name: Enervate
skills.description: Deals 845 (779 + 160% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and burns 528 mana over 5s. Decreases healing effectiveness -60% and increases duration of Stun and Trip +30%.

ranks.description: Deals 845 (779 + 160% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and burns 528 mana over 5s. Decreases healing effectiveness -60% and increases duration of Stun and Trip +30%.

skills.name: Focal Concussion
skills.description:
Deals 528 (424 + 250% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and Stuns an enemy for 1.5s.
If the target has any positive buffs, Focal Concussion removes one buff and deals additional damage when the Stun ends.

ranks.description:

ranks.description: Enlightened (Hollow): Deals Magic Damage and Stuns an enemy for 1.5s. Removes 1 positive buff (+1 extra per Baleful Recharge stack) and deals bonus pop damage when the Stun ends.

skills.name: Dahuta's Breath
skills.description:
Sends forth a wave that deals 959 (835 + 300% Magic Attack) Magic Damage and pushes enemies away from you.
Pushed enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills.
This skill counts as a Push effect.

skills.name: Bubble Trap
skills.description: Traps an enemy inside a bubble (5.4s PvP / 10.8s PvE) and slowly lifts it into the air. Enemies in bubbles cannot attack and take -50% Magic Damage until freed by direct damage.

skills.name: Bubble Trap (Mist)
skills.description: Summons a mist at the target location for 15s, trapping enemies entering the 4m radius inside a bubble for 5.0s.

skills.name: Insidious Whisper
skills.description: Inflicts Fear on an enemy for 2.8s (PvP), causing them to flee. Direct attacks have a chance to break Fear early.

skills.name: Lassitude
skills.description: Magically fatigues the target, inflicting Sleep (3.5s PvP / 7s PvE) after a 2.0s delay. Direct damage wakes the target.

skills.name: Banshee Wail
skills.description: Inflicts AoE Fear on nearby enemies for 2.8s, followed automatically by a 2.0s Stun.

skills.name: Banshee Wail (Stone)
skills.description: Inflicts AoE Fear (2.8s) and reduces Move Speed -40% on nearby enemies (does not Stun afterwards).

skills.name: Banshee Wail (Mist)
skills.description: Summons a Phantasm at the target location for 6s that pulses AoE Fear (2.8s) → Stun (2.0s) within 5m.

skills.name: Purge
skills.utilitySummary: Strips 1 enemy buff (or cleanses 1 ally debuff)
skills.description: Enemies: Removes 1 beneficial buff. Allies: Removes 1 negative debuff.

skills.name: Earthen Grip (Wave)
skills.description:
Calls forth a hand from the ground to hold an enemy, inflicting Snare for 12s (6s PvP).
Deals 177 (86 + 220% Magic Attack) Magic Damage upon expiration.
Reduced cast time (0.5s) and shorter range compared to regular Earthen Grip.

ranks.label: Rank 1
ranks.description: Snares enemy for 12s (6s PvP) and deals 86 + 220% Magic Attack Magic Damage on expiration. Faster cast time (0.5s), shorter range.

skills.name: Bubble Trap (Gale)
skills.utilitySummary: Short-CD Bubbled CC (4.4s PvP / 8.8s PvE, 21s CD)
skills.description:
Traps an enemy inside a bubble (4.4s PvP / 8.8s PvE) and slowly lifts it into the air. Enemies in bubbles cannot attack and take -50% Magic Damage until freed by direct damage.
Reduced cooldown (21s) and shorter range compared to regular Bubble Trap.

skills.name: Devour Hope
skills.utilitySummary: Hopelessness (5s PvP: +10–15s cooldown on cast skills)
skills.description:
Inflicts Hopelessness on your chosen victim for 5s. Any skills cast during this debuff have their cooldowns increased by +10s (+15s at Rank 2).
Can only be used in PvP.

skills.name: Stonesight
skills.description:
Unleashes the gaze of the terrifying Gorgon, petrifying all enemies facing the caster within a 15m cone. Enemies remain petrified until the caster stops channeling.
Additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing range.
